title: Mystic Ward
wikitext:
[[Image:The Mystic Ward.jpg|thumb|The Mystic Ward]]
'''The Mystic Ward''' was established for the study of magic. It features a number of merchants that cater to mages, as well as [[trainers]] for [[mage]]s, [[warlocks]], [[paladin]]s, and [[priest]]s, who reside in the eldritch [[Hall of Mysteries]]. A number of very powerful magic users reside within this area, and there are a few shops that sell magical goods.

To get to the Mystic Ward, you can head north from the [[Commons]], northwest from the [[Great Forge]], or west from the [[Forlorn Cavern]].
